name: The Lion Follies
source:
A short, FREE comedy/romance visual novel that takes place in the Final Fantasy XIV universe. 

You play the role of a spirited botanist who partakes in a series of misadventures with a surly lion man protector. No knowledge of Final Fantasy XIV is needed to enjoy this visual novel.

[From [url=https://beastfollies.itch.io/the-lion-follies]Itch.io[/url]]
